news.title: "CM monitoring every hour": TN Health Minister assures preparedness as IMD predicts heavy rainfall across state
news.og_desc: As the India Meteorological Department (IMD) issues warnings of heavy to very heavy rainfall across Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, and Karaikal, State Health Minister KG Arunraj reviewed monsoon preparedness and relief operations at the Directorate of Medical and Rural Health Services (DMS) campus. Reassuring the public amidst ongoing weather alerts, Minister Arunraj highlighted the continuous monitoring by Chief Minister MK Stalin and emphasised that ground-level operations have restored normal conditions despite persistent downpours. Speaking on the state's readiness, Health Minister KG Arunraj emphasised the intense oversight being maintained across administrative bodies to mitigate urban flooding and waterlogging. "The CM had been continuously monitoring almost every hour. He wanted to know the updates every hour. We, all the in-charge ministers, corporation officials and other staff, are in the field. Successfully, we have brought the situation to normal. It shows the amount of preparedness and the amount of work we have done. Definitely, because of all these instructions and the directions of the CM, we are confident that this same intensity of measures will continue, and we'll successfully tackle this monsoon season," he said. The inspection at the DMS campus formed part of the state's broader efforts to assess preparedness and strengthen coordination among departments during the monsoon. Health services and emergency response arrangements remain important components of disaster preparedness, particularly during periods of heavy rainfall and potential flooding. The minister's remarks underlined the administration's focus on continuous monitoring, coordination among field officials and maintaining readiness to address emerging challenges. The state government has expressed confidence in its preparedness measures as it continues to monitor conditions and respond to monsoon-related requirements across Tamil Nadu. Heavy downpours continued to lash Chennai and neighbouring areas, triggering severe waterlogging in several low-lying pockets. Ennore Port recorded a staggering 222.5 mm of rainfall in 24 hours, topping the regional charts as intense convective clouds swept across north coastal Tamil Nadu. The overnight deluge heavily impacted North Chennai, with Ennore, Tiruvottiyur and Manali reporting significant water accumulation. Central business districts including Broadway, Prakasam Salai, Mannadi and Parry's Corner were badly hit, with localised water levels touching nearly 30 cm. The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) attributed the relentless wet spell to an active cyclonic circulation over northern Tamil Nadu and adjoining southern coastal Andhra Pradesh. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), widespread rainfall is expected to persist across Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal till October 24. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has said that widespread rainfall is likely to continue across Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal till October 24, keeping the southern peninsula under a prolonged wet spell. The IMD has issued a very heavy rain warning for isolated places across the region from October 19 to October 21. These heavy spells are expected to be accompanied by thunderstorms, lightning and strong gusty winds reaching 40-50 kmph, gusting up to 60 kmph. The intensity is likely to ease slightly from October 22, though isolated heavy rainfall is still expected to persist till October 24. With severe weather warnings in place, thousands of civic workers, disaster response teams and corporation officials remain deployed to clear blockages, drain stagnant water and manage relief operations. Residents in vulnerable low-lying areas have been advised to exercise caution as round-the-clock monitoring continues. (ANI)

article.summary: Tottenham Hotspur hosts Coventry City tonight as the club fights to exit the bottom of the Premier League table.
article.body: Tottenham Hotspur sits at the bottom of the Premier League table after six games, a position few supporters anticipated following a summer transfer window that saw the club spend in excess of £300m. The team currently languishes in last place, a significant drop from their position of fourth-bottom previously. For a side that has historically faced cycles of disappointment, this current campaign has presented a persistent struggle to secure points, turning a season of high financial investment into a period of deep frustration. Supporters, accustomed to the team's tendency for erratic form, now view each match as a critical opportunity to reverse the club's fortunes. Despite the negative results, recent performances under manager Roberto De Zerbi have shown signs of improvement, offering a glimmer of hope that the squad might finally break their winless streak against Coventry. The pressure on the players remains immense as they look to transition from a winless start to earning their first three points of the season. The Guardian reports that the current malaise seems deeply encoded within the club’s recent history, making tonight’s fixture a vital test of their resilience. Fans are watching closely to see if the team can overcome the tactical and psychological barriers that have plagued them since the start of the season. Following tonight’s game, Tottenham must continue to navigate a difficult Premier League schedule to climb away from the relegation zone. Management remains focused on stabilizing the squad’s performance to ensure the investment made during the summer months begins to reflect in the final league standings.

news.title: Una gran cruz cayó sobre un sacerdote en Ecuador
news.og_title: Una gran cruz cayó sobre un sacerdote en Ecuador
news.og_desc: Un sacerdote falleció el sábado en la ciudad ecuatoriana de Guayaquil, la más poblada del país, después de caerle encima una gran cruz mientras realizaba una misa que se estaba transmitiendo en directo por redes sociales. El sacerdote fue identificado como Patricio Sánchez Molinari y estaba en la mitad de la ceremonia, frente al altar, cuando una gran cruz de madera con un Jesús crucificado, que estaba colgada en la pared, cayó hacia adelante y lo golpeó en la cabeza. Sánchez pertenecía a la congregación del Santísimo Redentor, una comunidad misionera fundada en 1732, y estaba al frente de la iglesia Nuestra Señora del Perpetuo Socorro, localizada en el centro-sur de Guayaquil.

article.headline: فيفا يوقف حسام وإبراهيم حسن 3 مباريات وزيكو 5 مباريات رسميا
article.summary: قررت لجنة الانضباط بـ«فيفا» إيقاف حسام وإبراهيم حسن 3 مباريات ومصطفى زيكو 5 مباريات على خلفية أحداث مواجهة الأرجنتين بكأس العالم 2026.
article.body: تلقى الاتحاد المصري لكرة القدم قرارات لجنة الانضباط بالاتحاد الدولي لكرة القدم «فيفا» بإيقاف المدير الفني للمنتخب حسام حسن ومدير المنتخب إبراهيم حسن لمدة ثلاث مباريات لكل منهما، مع إيقاف اللاعب مصطفى عبد الرؤوف «زيكو» لمدة خمس مباريات. تأتي هذه العقوبات نتيجة ملف تأديبي فتحه الاتحاد الدولي في أغسطس الماضي، عقب التصريحات التي أدلى بها الثلاثي بعد مباراة مصر والأرجنتين في دور الـ16 لكأس العالم 2026، والتي انتهت بخسارة المنتخب المصري بنتيجة 3-2.  تعد هذه القرارات ذات أهمية بالغة لمسيرة المنتخب المصري وجهازه الفني، حيث تسعى إدارة الاتحاد المصري لكرة القدم حاليًا للتعامل مع الموقف القانوني المترتب على هذه العقوبات. تؤثر هذه الإيقافات بشكل مباشر على تشكيل الجهاز الفني وقائمة اللاعبين المتاحين للمشاركات الدولية المقبلة للفراعنة، مما يضع الاتحاد في موقف يتطلب سرعة اتخاذ قرارات إدارية وقانونية لضمان استقرار العمل الفني.  من جانبه، أعلن الاتحاد المصري لكرة القدم عن تقديم طلب رسمي إلى لجنة الانضباط بـ«فيفا» للحصول على الأسباب والحيثيات التفصيلية التي استندت إليها اللجنة في إصدار تلك العقوبات. وأكد الاتحاد في بيان رسمي أن الاطلاع على هذه الحيثيات يمثل خطوة أساسية لتقييم الموقف القانوني بشكل دقيق، تمهيدًا لدراسة إمكانية تقديم استئناف ضد القرارات الصادرة وفقًا للوائح المتبعة. وتأتي هذه الخطوة في إطار مساعي الاتحاد للدفاع عن حقوق الأطراف المعنية بالعقوبات، حيث لا يزال الملف مفتوحًا بانتظار الرد على طلب الحيثيات والبدء في إجراءات الاستئناف الممكنة لتقليص العقوبات أو إلغائها.
